summary: Full E2E testing of Justlocal MVP. Backend: created pytest suite with 21 tests covering health, auth (register/login/me/duplicate/short password), catalog (categories/medicines with filters/pharmacies/offers), orders (auth + list + create + persistence), addresses, prescription upload. Initial run: 19/21 passed. Fixed 1 critical backend bug (POST /api/orders 500 due to MongoDB _id leak) and 1 test artefact; retest 21/21 passed. Frontend: mobile Playwright suite verified login with prefilled demo credentials, home render, tab navigation across all 5 tabs, add-to-cart, cart modal, checkout, place order, orders tab, tracking modal, account screen, and logout back to auth. All flows passed. Minor deprecated icon detected: Ionicons has no 'medical-bag' - warning in seed data.

issues: Console warning: 'medical-bag' is not a valid Ionicons name (used for 'Prescription Medicines' category in seed data). Fallback '?' icon shown.

action_items: In /app/backend/server.py seed_database(), replace icon 'medical-bag' with a valid Ionicons name (e.g. 'medkit' or 'medical') for the first category to remove the console warning and blank icon. Note: existing DB already seeded; the seed only inserts when count == 0. Either update the doc via a migration or drop and reseed categories collection.

Consider adding testID props to key interactive elements (Log in, tabs, Add, Continue to checkout, Place order, Log out) so future tests are more robust. Currently reachable by text/role but that's fragile if copy changes.
Optional: add response_model or explicit projection to POST /api/orders to prevent future ObjectId leaks (already patched by excluding _id manually).
critical_code_review_comments: index.tsx is ~64 lines but essentially all one-liners; consider splitting into smaller components (Auth, Home, Cart, etc) for maintainability - each function is 100+ chars wide.

POST /api/orders used to return the raw insert document including MongoDB '_id'. Fixed by excluding _id in return statement. Recommend using an explicit Pydantic response_model to enforce this at the framework level.
server.py routes are correctly prefixed with /api and env vars (MONGO_URL, DB_NAME, JWT_SECRET) come from env - good.
Frontend uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL with Constants fallback - good.
All text is properly wrapped in Text components; styles use StyleSheet-like objects via makeStyles - good.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing demo user (demo@justlocal.app) and seeded catalog. Test-generated users use test_<uuid>@justlocal.test emails and are left in DB (small, harmless).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py; run with `pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`. BASE URL comes from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL env. Demo credentials at /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Frontend has no testIDs - use text/role selectors on mobile viewport (390x844). Known cosmetic issue: 'medical-bag' Ionicons warning (seed data).
rca_of_issue: POST /api/orders returned 500 with PydanticSerializationError: Unable to serialize unknown type: <class 'bson.objectid.ObjectId'>. Motor's insert_one() mutates the input dict to add '_id' (BSON ObjectId). The endpoint then returned that dict filtered only for 'user_id', still exposing '_id' which FastAPI/Pydantic cannot serialize since no response_model was set. Fix: exclude both 'user_id' and '_id' in the returned dict. Verified via TestOrders.test_create_order (POST + GET verify persistence).
